entities.name: Aryl nitro reduction
observations: The decoded transformation converts an aryl nitro group (Ar–NO2) to an aryl amino group (Ar–NH2), retaining the methylpyridyl-biphenyl scaffold.
Candidate reagent classes are catalytic hydrogenation or metal-mediated reduction; no unique reagent is encoded by the reactant and product structures.
